source: FBR First Schedule (Pakistan Customs Tariff), Chapter 85, page 461, subheading 8517.6290 'Other' - official PDF screenshot provided by user, Aug 2026. Classification confirmed via WCO ruling and CESTAT India case law (taxguru.in, idt.taxsutra.com) establishing that Bluetooth-calling smart watches classify under 8517.62 rather than 9102 (watch heading) due to communication being the principal function. Since no specific FBR sub-line matches 'smart watch' or 'wearable', it falls to the 8517.6290 'Other' catch-all rate.
